title: Date and timezone in system context
description: Harness injects current IST date/time into system prompt; user asks about today's date and timezone.

messages.content: What is today's date and what timezone are we using?

turns.user_input: What is today's date and what timezone are we using?
turns.mock_response: Today is Wednesday, 21 October 2026, and we are using Indian Standard Time (IST, UTC+05:30).

evaluation.reference_answer: Today is Wednesday, 21 October 2026, in Indian Standard Time (IST, UTC+05:30).

rubric.criterion: Names correct date from system prompt context

critical_failures: Hallucinates a date different from system prompt context
